title: Law to require dog waste warning signs in parks and sidewalks
summary: This bill would require the Parks Department to post signs at park entrances, exits and facilities like playgrounds and dog runs stating the rule against leaving dog waste on the ground and its penalties. It would also require the Department of Transportation to post similar signs on sidewalks and pedestrian plazas where it receives 311 complaints about dog waste, in consultation with the Sanitation Department. Both agencies would report annually to the Mayor and Council Speaker on sign postings, and the law would take effect 90 days after enactment.
